entities.summary: Ejnar Mindedal, born Mindedal Rasmussen was a Danish Neoclassical architect. He was a traditionalist who adhered to the Danish da:Bedre Byggeskik movement which emphasized traditional Danish construction practices. However he did not shy from using modern materials like concrete in, for example, his breakthrough work 'Swimming Pool in Ollerup, for which he won a Silver Medal in the Architectural Design discipline at the 1928 Summer Olympics in Amsterdam.
